in_marathi.name: महेश
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: महेश हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Mahésh originates from Sanskrit and is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mahá' meaning 'great' and 'isha' meaning 'lord'. In Hindu mythology, Mahésh is considered the supreme god, the creator of the universe, and the god of all gods. He is often depicted as a calm and compassionate deity, who bestows blessings upon his devotees.
